name: agentstate
display_name: AgentState (by Antinel) — AI Agent Audit Chain
description: Local-first audit chain and ledger for AI coding agents: every tool call recorded on a tamper-evident hash chain, dangerous operations intercepted (24 rules / 4 gates), daily ledger (what did it do / what did it cost / what was blocked). Zero cloud, standard library only, third-party verifiable.

tools.name: antinel_digest
tools.description: Daily ledger: operations, blocks, token spend per project/host (last N days)

tools.name: antinel_verify
tools.description: Recompute the audit chain: CLEAN or point at the exact tampered record

tools.name: antinel_host_audit
tools.description: Host-level agent integration audit (which hosts are covered, known exfil paths)

tools.name: antinel_report
tools.description: Session report: what this session did and cost, every number labelled measured/estimated/user-reported

pricing.notes: no key, no rate limit, no network egress
